main.description: Return aggregated vessel density inside a bbox, suitable for low-zoom heatmap rendering. ADR-2605011500. Phase 1: backed by mv_vessel_density_grid (0.1° lat/lon grid ~11km equator) — RisingWave 2.8.1 has no h3_lat_lng_to_cell builtin, so true H3 res-6 is deferred to Phase 2 (Python/Rust UDF wrapping h3o). The h3Resolution param is accepted for forward-compat but currently ignored; cellSchema in the response indicates which rendering path to use.

h3Resolution.description: Reserved for Phase 2 (true H3). Accepted but ignored in Phase 1 grid mode. Default 5.

cells.description: Array of cell rows. Phase 1 (cellSchema='grid_0p1deg'): { cell_id:string, lat_bin:number, lon_bin:number, vessel_count, hit_count, byClass: { [type_class]: { vessel_count, hit_count } } }. lat_bin/lon_bin = south-west corner of the 0.1°×0.1° cell. Phase 2 (cellSchema='h3_r6'): { cell_id:string (H3 hex), vessel_count, hit_count, byClass }.

cellSchema.description: 'grid_0p1deg' (Phase 1) or 'h3_r6' (Phase 2). Tells the client how to render cell_id.
